No. 1993/24– THURSDAY, NOVEMBER, 17, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: RPDS/LND/09/ACQ/UDA/01. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: 4-3/10/2014/UDA/23.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a Public Purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Following allotments of land depicted as Lot No. 592 & 593 in extent 13.4764 Hectare in the Preliminary Plan No. 342 prepared by Survey General situated in Hidellana Village of New Town Grama Niladari Division of Divisional Secretary’s Division Rathnapura in the District of Rathnapura in Sabaragamuwa Province. 01. Lot No. 592 Name of the Land: Eriyagahadeniye Kumbura, Kanuketiye Kumbura, Kanuketiyegodella, Palm Garden Estate Details of the Land, Barren Paddy Field; Claimant: Government, incipient claimant Balangoda Plantation Ltd. P. B. 06, Palmgarden, Ratnapura, Land Reformation Commission, Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07; Extent: 2.1466 Hectares.

01. Lot No. 593 Name of the land: Palm Garden Estate, Eriyagahadeniye Kumbura, Kanuketiye Kumbura, Details of the land: Estate, There is 8-10 years old Rubber cultivation; Claimant: Government, incipient claimant Balangoda Plantation Ltd. P. B. 06, Palmgarden, Ratnapura, Land Reformation Commission, Hector Kobbedaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07; Extent: 11.3298 Hectares.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby requested to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a. m. on 28th December 2016, at Rathnapura Divisional Secretariat.

Moreover, they are hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two duplicates on or before the 21st day of December 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their clams for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
C. M. KOTTAWATHTHA, Divisional Secretary, Rathnapura. At Divisional Secretariat-Rathnapura 10th day of November, 2016. 12 - 124
